senses.zh_definition: SuawaSauro：见于部分马来语影视字幕制作署名的别名；不具有已核实的普通词汇释义。
senses.en_definition: SuawaSauro, an alias appearing in credits for some Malay-language subtitles.
senses.ms_definition: Nama samaran SuawaSauro yang ditemukan dalam kredit penyediaan sesetengah sari kata bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词；上述马来语释义是对可见署名的说明，并非 DBP 定义。[Southpaw 马来语字幕预览](https://isubtitles.org/southpaw/malay-subtitles/834052)显示该名字出现在字幕制作署名中。以下为署名格式或说明性组合，不宣称是高频词汇搭配；也不据此推断账号背后的具体个人。

etymology.historical_story: The available evidence places SuawaSauro in the credit lines of Malay-language subtitles, illustrating how online aliases can enter text collections alongside ordinary dialogue. A frequency list can therefore contain a contributor name without that name being a Malay vocabulary item. The alias’s creator, intended pronunciation, internal composition and original naming story remain unverified; no linguistic origin should be invented.
